summary: iOThree Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting shareholder resolutions from an August 21, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting. Shareholders approved increasing authorized ordinary shares from 70 million to 1 billion (par $0.0625) and a reverse share split consolidating every eight existing shares into one share (par $0.50), conditional on Nasdaq clearance, with fractional shares rounded up. A further consolidation of not less than 1-for-2 and not more than 1-for-1 was also authorized. Quorum was 99.23% of votes; all proposals passed with over 99.99% support. The reverse split appears aimed at boosting share price to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, a structural recapitalization rather than an M&A event.
